parameters.query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "Emerald_Release_Log" ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, emerald_row_id BIGINT UNIQUE, contact_email TEXT, ghl_contact_id TEXT, sender_email TEXT NOT NULL, release_date DATE NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE, release_ts TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(), status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued', run_id TEXT ); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS emerald_release_log_idx_sender_date ON "Emerald_Release_Log" (sender_email, release_date);

SELECT e.id AS emerald_row_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.primary_email AS email, e.primary_phone AS phone, e.company_name, e.contact_city AS city, e.contact_state AS state, NULL::text AS country, row_to_json(e)->>'timezone' AS timezone, row_to_json(e)->>'contact_timezone' AS contact_timezone, e.tags FROM "Emerald_Contacts" e WHERE COALESCE(e.primary_email,'') <> '' AND COALESCE(e.tags,'') ILIKE '%emerald%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Emerald_Release_Log" r WHERE r.emerald_row_id = e.id) ORDER BY e.id ASC LIMIT {{$item(0).$node["Config"].json.candidateLimit}};

SELECT sender_email, due_today FROM ( SELECT sender_email, COUNT(*)::int AS due_today FROM "Emerald_Release_Log" WHERE release_date IN (CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 day', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '4 day', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 day', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '11 day') GROUP BY sender_email UNION ALL SELECT '__none__'::text AS sender_email, 0::int AS due_today ) x;

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_unreleased FROM "Emerald_Contacts" e WHERE COALESCE(e.primary_email,'') <> '' AND COALESCE(e.tags,'') ILIKE '%emerald%' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Emerald_Release_Log" r WHERE r.emerald_row_id = e.id);

INSERT INTO "Emerald_Release_Log" (emerald_row_id, contact_email, ghl_contact_id, sender_email, release_date, release_ts, status, run_id) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,CURRENT_DATE,NOW(),'queued',$5) ON CONFLICT (emerald_row_id) DO NOTHING;
